comparator_fix.rule: A blob alias in a .rodata string section is rendered as text only when the complete NUL-terminated byte span matches the alias size and SHA-256 and decodes as UTF-8.

root_cause: The stock ELF literal haptic_hv was normalized as a 10-byte opaque blob because a local ELF symbol covered it; the candidate ELF literal was normalized as a string. The bytes and NUL terminator are identical, but the assembly comparator had no blob-to-string normalization for this exact case.
scope: The normalization changes only relocation labels for byte-identical, single-NUL UTF-8 strings; it does not waive opcode, call target, string-content, section, or symbol-size checks.
